name: lemon-cake
display_name: pay-per-call-mcp — USDC Billing for AI Agents · Demo Mode (no signup)
description: Give your AI agent a USDC wallet. Pay-per-call billing for any HTTP API with x402-compatible receipts, spend limits, and Demo Mode that works instantly — no signup needed. Includes Japan tax invoice check (国税庁).
long_description:
## 🚀 30-second start (no signup, no USDC needed)

1. Install this server in Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf
2. Leave ALL credential fields empty — it boots in DEMO MODE automatically
3. Ask Claude: "Use the setup tool to show me what's available"
4. Try a real free API: "Search Wikipedia for 'MCP protocol' using demo_search"

That's it. No account. No credit card. Three live APIs (Wikipedia search, live FX rates, httpbin echo) work for free in Demo Mode.

💬 Stuck? Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/JBekn3EF — we reply fast.

---

## Going live (paid APIs)

5. Create a free account at https://lemoncake.xyz/dashboard
6. Top up USDC (minimum $1 — covers ~100 API calls)
7. Copy your Pay Token from Dashboard → Tokens
8. Paste it into the "Pay Token" field in the Inspector
9. Ask Claude: "List all available services" → call any of 16+ APIs (Serper, Hunter.io, Firecrawl, Jina, IPinfo, gBizINFO, 国税庁, and more)

---

## What this server does

LemonCake gives any AI agent a USDC wallet. Instead of 15 different API keys, the agent uses one Pay Token (a JWT with a hard spending cap, expiry, and service scope). LemonCake handles per-call billing across the whole marketplace.

Tools:
- setup — interactive onboarding, works without credentials
- list_services — browse 16+ APIs with prices and usage hints
- call_service — execute any marketplace API, auto-billed in USDC
- check_balance — USDC balance and account info
- check_tax — Japanese 適格請求書 validation + 源泉徴収 calculation
- get_service_stats — aggregate marketplace usage numbers

Safety: Pay Token has limitUsdc / scope / expiresAt baked in. The agent physically cannot overspend. Token revocation is instant.

💬 Questions? https://discord.gg/JBekn3EF | Docs: https://lemoncake.xyz | GitHub: https://github.com/evidai/lemon-cake

pay_token.title: Pay Token — OPTIONAL (leave empty for instant Demo Mode)
pay_token.description:
🎮 Leave this EMPTY to try Demo Mode right now — no signup, no account, no USDC needed. Three real free APIs (Wikipedia search, live FX rates, httpbin echo) work immediately.

Only fill this in when you want to call real paid APIs (Serper, Hunter, Tavily, etc.). Get your Pay Token from https://lemoncake.xyz/dashboard after creating a free account.

buyer_jwt.title: Buyer JWT — OPTIONAL (leave empty for Demo Mode)
buyer_jwt.description:
🎮 Leave this EMPTY — Demo Mode works without it. Only needed for `check_balance` on a real account.

Get your Buyer JWT from https://lemoncake.xyz/dashboard → API Keys.

api_url.title: API base URL
api_url.description: LemonCake API base URL. Leave empty to use the production endpoint (https://api.lemoncake.xyz).

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Interactive on-boarding: shows what credentials you have, what's missing, and how to get them. No auth required.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List approved API services available in the marketplace (Serper, Hunter.io, gBizINFO, etc.). No auth required. Returns id, name, provider, pricePerCall, and per-service usage hint (path/method/body) so the agent can construct the correct call_service request without trial-and-error.

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Invoke an upstream API service through the pay-per-call proxy. Charges USDC against the Pay Token. Returns upstream response verbatim plus chargeId and amountUsdc. 4xx responses include a structured `hint` field with actionable guidance (e.g. 401=auth issue, 402=balance exhausted, 422=service uneconomical). Requires LEMON_CAKE_PAY_TOKEN.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Returns current USDC balance, KYC tier, and account info. Requires LEMON_CAKE_BUYER_JWT.

tools.name: check_tax
tools.description: Japanese tax compliance check: qualified-invoice (適格請求書) registration validation against 国税庁, plus source-withholding (源泉徴収) determination. Returns the registration name, validity, and whether withholding applies for the given amount. No auth required.

tools.name: get_service_stats
tools.description: Aggregate marketplace usage statistics (call count, top services, unique buyers). No auth required.

prompts.name: explore-demo
prompts.description: Walk through demo_search → demo_fx → demo_echo to see the call_service plumbing without spending real USDC.
prompts.text: Use the LemonCake `setup` tool first to confirm we're in DEMO MODE, then call `call_service` with serviceId `demo_search` (q: "AI agent payments"), then `demo_fx` (no body), then `demo_echo` (any JSON). Report back the X-Charge-Id headers (which will be DEMO mock IDs) and explain why nothing was actually billed.

prompts.name: discover-marketplace
prompts.description: Discover all marketplace services and pick one based on price + use case.
prompts.text: Use `list_services` to enumerate every paid API in the LemonCake marketplace. For each, note the price per call and the `usage` hint. Then recommend the single best service for: (1) B2B email lookup, (2) live web search, (3) reading a webpage as Markdown. Cite the exact serviceId and pricePerCall for each recommendation.

prompts.name: japan-tax-check
prompts.description: Validate a Japanese invoice number (T + 13 digits) and determine source-withholding for a given amount.
prompts.text: Use `check_tax` to validate the Japanese qualified-invoice registration number `T1234567890123` for a service-fee transaction of 110,000 JPY. Report (a) whether the number is currently valid, (b) the registered name, (c) whether source-withholding (源泉徴収) applies and the amount. Explain the result in plain Japanese.

prompts.name: spend-with-budget
prompts.description: Demonstrate hard-cap spending: call a service with a strict USDC budget that the agent cannot exceed.
prompts.text: Explain how a LemonCake Pay Token enforces a hard USDC spending cap that the agent physically cannot exceed (limitUsdc claim baked into the JWT). Then simulate it: call `demo_search` 3 times in a row through `call_service`, and after each call, call `check_balance` and report the remaining mock balance. Stop if the simulated remaining balance hits zero.

prompts.name: real-vs-demo
prompts.description: Compare a demo service response against a real upstream response to validate plumbing before going live.
prompts.text: Call `demo_search` (mock) and a real marketplace search service (use `list_services` to find one — likely Serper) with the same query "Anthropic MCP". Show the response shape side by side. Note which fields are present in the real response but missing in the demo, so the agent author knows what to expect when migrating from demo to live.

prompts.name: japan-finance-bundle
prompts.description: Run a Japan-flavored research bundle: corporate lookup (gBizINFO) → invoice number validation (国税庁) → tax compliance summary.
prompts.text: For Japanese corporate research: (1) use `list_services` to find gBizINFO and call it with corporate number 3010001088782 to get the company profile, (2) extract the invoice registration number from the profile if available, (3) call `check_tax` with that number, (4) summarize: company name, address, capital, invoice status, withholding requirement. Report in Japanese.
